dogecoin.text: The SEC has postponed its decision on altcoin ETFs, including XRP, Solana, Litecoin, and Dogecoin, until May. Analysts suggest this is standard and not a cause for concern. Final deadlines aren't until October, pending confirmation of SEC chair pick Paul Atkins. #Crypto2025

Dogecoin millionaires are buying the dip as DOGE eyes a potential 30% rally. Onchain data shows a rise in wallets with 1M+ DOGE and increased network activity, hinting at a possible price rebound. DOGE currently tests critical support levels. #Crypto2025 #Bitcoin2025 #Blockchain

SEC clarifies that proof-of-work mining does not count as securities dealing under specific criteria. This decision supports decentralized PoW networks like Bitcoin, Dogecoin, and Litecoin, boosting the pro-crypto stance under President Trump's administration. #Crypto2025
